Their aerobatics fascinate the she-bear that Grizzy is in love with, which gives him the idea of replacing the shopping cart with a double-seat and inviting his beloved for a sky promenade. But confiscating a wing in mid-flight is not within the reach of just any old bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: In this fairy episode, due to a strike on the head and seeing the fairy story book pictures, the Lemmings believe they are the dwarves from the tale Snow White, and start attacking the cabin with pickaxes. After that Grizzy also believes he is Snow White due to same incidence.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings' favorite chocolate spread brand is organizing a big competition where the prize is a giant jar of spread. To win, one must make ten baskets in a row in a hoop set up on a supermarket parking lot for the occasion. Ready to play?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Freed from the ice which had preserved him for millions of years, a saber-toothed bear bursts into the cabin, starving to death. But when they realize that a prehistoric necklace will enable them to control the creature, it's each man for himself again!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush is very proud he invented a new game called Fruity Bounce, where he and his friends bounce as high as possible on the bouncier fruits they can find. Mushlers vs Mushups, game on !

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the ranger's latest acquisition: a 3D printer that will duplicate anything at all in miniature format. programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.desc: When Max drags the kids to see a defunct "House of the Future" built by his childhood idol, Ben discovers Steam Smythe is busy excavating the joint...

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: While Ben, Gwen, and Max hike to a waterfall, the Bugg Brothers are back with a plan to duplicate Diamondhead, but when their cloning ray gun fires on Max instead - multiplying him endlessly - Gwen and Ben must round up all the Maxes while also fighting off the Bugg Brothers.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

More by luck than talent Bean wins the match – only to find that now he has to fight the terrifying Bruise Force.

Instead he goes home and paints a picture of the bird cuts it out and sticks it high up a tree in the back garden. Soon he is besieged by excited twitchers who think it really is the rare bird. They are all keen to get a snap and they’re willing to pay good money for a peek.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

Bean tries every trick in the book to sneak himself into the party – even resorting to hiding inside an enormous cake. If only he knew the real reason for the celebration.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series

Its gardening gloves off when Mr Bean goes into battle with his rival green-fingered competitors.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.desc: The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings

Unfortunately, it's dark before he can finish, but he's not going to stop, despite the difficulties of building in the dark. As for the Baby Lemmings, they're enjoying the spectacle of shooting stars when suddenly one of them crashes not far from them! A pretty, shiny, luminous stone. They decide to send it back up into the sky with the other stars. But Baby Beaver would love this luminous stone, which would enable him to continue his work even in the dark.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is captivated by a mime artist on TV who makes viewers believe in the presence of an invisible wall. To get rid of the Lemmings, who have sights on his jar of Yummy, Grizzy hides the jar and pretends he has an invisible one. When the Lemmings see through the trick, they decide to trap Grizzy with a grand illusion number.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings shiver with cold, sneeze and are glassy-eyed: they have a big fat cold! They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto the electronic version of the "Ranger Lemming" toy which is capable of reproducing the movements one teaches it, like a smart robot. Grizzy immediately grasps the potential of a robot that could perform chores with rapidity and precision, but the Lemmings would rather teach it to dance.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves playing in the neighbourhood soft play centre – bouncing on the trampolines whizzing down the slides and most of all immersing himself in the ball pool. But he doesn’t like sharing the place with all those annoying kids. So Bean decides to turn his flat into his own private play area where he can play in peace. Unfortunately Irma Mrs Wicket and The Bruisers all want to join in the fun with him.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity is cut off so he builds a wind turbine – all fine until there’s too much wind! / Mr Bean attempts to retrieve his cash card and ‘accidently’ ends up inside a bank vault. / Mr Bean is tired of litterbugs and attempts to clean up the whole town himself…with disastrous results. / Mr Bean has to deal with an unwanted house guest but the stubborn pest refuses to leave.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is in the library to draw the family tree of kings. When an old lady shows him that he looks like a king named Lord Bean in the book she is reading, Bean heads from London to Scotland where Lord Bean's castle is located, to explore. There he accidentally discovers secret places and as he finds the real identical Lord Bean, he gets him out.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to impress Irma by entering them both into a dance competition at the local park. But his tango is terrible and his rumba ridiculous so he enrols for lessons at a local dance school. After an unsuccessful class at the dance studio and a trip to the library to teach himself Mr Bean has lost track of time. He needs to make it up to a disgruntled Irma but will his homemade effort ‘win’ her over.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean manages to get himself locked in a department store overnight while spending too long trying on clothes. Bean takes advantage of the situation having fun in the various departments. But when he discovers a robbery taking place the fun and games stop as the desperate burglar chases Bean from floor to floor and all around the store.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr. Bean becomes obsessed with gaming after being introduced by Mrs. Wicket's nephew. He decides he must have his own console only to discover how expensive they are. But as luck would have it he arrives at the shop at closing time to discover that tomorrow there will be a special sale. All he has to do is be first in line…

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs. Wicket demands that Bean stay in to take delivery of a new lounge chair. He is forced to dress up as Mrs. Wicket when Brian the Delivery Man won't deliver the chair to anyone but Mrs. Wicket. Then Brian falls in love with 'her' and asks 'her' out on a date. Bean accepts because he's starving hungry. How long can he keep up the deception? Long enough to fill his stomach?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that an ant convoy marching in formation to a berry bush and back can be turned into a fun game of “conveyor belt” for them. However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears. Grizzy is now obliged to treat them like brothers as well.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge. Grizzy and the Lemmings will do everything to break up this budding romance and recover the cold sources that are rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

The mystery: a frightening Egyptian crocodile deity is terrorizing the museum. programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby's favorite chef is finally opening his own restaurant but a monstrous Yeti threatens the opening night. The gang has to solve the mystery before dessert is served, while Shaggy and Scooby have to resist eating all the food that's meant for the customers!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: During a visit to the farm of Penny Bennyson's grandfather, Team Tennyson is constantly haunted by a Scare-Crow that's come to life, thanks to Aristocrow.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Team Tennyson travels to Wheeler, "the liveliest mining town on Route 66".

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: When Max drags the kids to see a defunct "House of the Future" built by his childhood idol, Ben discovers Steam Smythe is busy excavating the joint...

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben is at the annual Big Bacon Pig Parade, but childhood "friend" Penny Heaven has met the family to ruin Ben's fun with her safety-obsessed self. While dodging Penny's overzealous safety precautions, Ben uncovers a plot by the BUG BROTHERS to steal helium from the parade balloons to rob banks with! Penny's badgering turns the heist into an accidental kidnapping so Ben must not only stop the robbery but save his least favorite "safety monitor" in the process.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: In a dark and cobwebby corner of his attic, Mr. Bean finds a treasure map. The hunt is on! But tricky clues lead Bean up the chimney, round the bend, down the garden path, up the blinking wall and nearly all the way to Australia.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is out shopping when it starts to rain. Taking refuge in a trendy coffee bar Bean is fascinated both by the brewing machinery and the amount of money people will pay for small cups of coffee! Scenting a fortune to be made Bean opens up his own strange successful coffee bar …

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wakes up freezing and learns that the boiler stopped working and there is no repairman insight; he tries ridiculous ways to warm up before giving up.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma wants a romantic break; Bean doesn’t. It’s too expensive. Irma kidnaps Teddy and refuses to give him back unless Bean promises to take her to Paris. Caught between his inability to pay and his love of Teddy Bean doesn’t know what to do! Until he spots a cat beauty competition in which first prize is a romantic break in Paris – if only he can catch Scrapper …

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: A team of detectives arrive on the scene in order to help some huskies search for the culprit who was on a mission to sabotage their win during a dog sled race.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: Tom has to enlist the neighborhood cats to help him remove the cat hairs from Rick's new massage chair.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry become obsessed with the contents of a wrapped package and go to extraordinary measures to find out what's inside without being caught by Rick and Ginger.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: When Lamput masquerades as a swimming trophy at the local pool, Skinny finds himself in his red trunks, warming up for the big race. You’d be surprised at how fast a Doc can swim when there’s a Lamput up for grabs. Skinny discovers skills not even he was aware of. Shame the trophies keep switching places. No lap-time in the world can outsmart this little orange blob.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: After pillaging a monastery, Yosemite Sam attempts to outwit an enlightened Bugs Bunny to receive the treasure of a lifetime. Then, Squeaks finds himself up against a small group of ninjas.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: The Inside Bugs: Yosemite Sam hopes to make a quick escape from a bank heist, and is surprised to discover Bugs is his getaway driver./Sun Valley Freeze: Bugs finds himself off the beaten path with Bigfoot when they realize the Hazmats are close on their tails. Bugs must do everything he can to protect Bigfoot while not becoming collateral damage himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy does not know how to put an end to the Lemmings’ new ball game. After devastating the cabinplaying dodgeball, the Lemmings admire the magic stone balls that whirl around the cabin like raginganimals. In a secret Stonehenge cavern, Grizzy discovers a glove that can stop the uncontrollable flying objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings have a new game. They fight over a crown to place on a stuffed animal in theirimage. After a first epic confrontation, Grizzy recovers the crown, but his stuffed animal has been damaged.Grizzy shoos the Lemmings far away and tries to repair his royal stuffed effigy. Meanwhile, the Lemmings discover a stuffed animal factory that might allow them to retake possession of the crown and win the match.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to take a nap but the Lemmings are goofing around astride a sheep inside the cabin. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out, but one of them is propelled into a strange crypt away from the others. When he comes into physical contact with a sharp mysterious tooth inside the crypt, the Lemming is transformed into a fearsome creature: the Were-Lemming!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant crate of Yummy chocolate spread along the roadside. Using guile, he discreetly stockshis loot inside the cabin without arousing the suspicions of the Lemmings, but they quickly catch onto his ruse. Grizzy throws the Lemmings out but he knows his peace is only temporary. He must develop an efficient anti-Lemming protection system. He opts for a hen who mistakes the Yummy jars for her eggs.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of jelly. During their battle, the jar soars into the air and gets stuck in an inaccessible high-up spot. The rivals throw themselves into the construction of a tower to reach their target first. Each side has his own personal style to attain the summits, and to cheat. Due to the whims of hazard – or perhaps their rush – the jar continues to slip away from them, landing in ever-higher places. Will Grizzy and the Lemmings be up to the challenge?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: While looking for a pack of instant gelatine in the garage, Grizzy happens upon a box of figurines. One of them looks just like him! Grizzy invents an imaginary game where his bear figurine turns into a great and powerful magician who will make a gelatine potion. The Lemmings discover that the magician has locked their figurines inside a cage. They decide to play along: the Lemmings Knights challenge the Bear Magician.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: On Halloween night, Poison Ivy brings Gotham City's pumpkins to life, unleashing an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that devour all the sweets. Redbird and Bam must put a stop to her scheme to save Gotham's Halloween festivities and their own.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it’s up to the rally car to dance his way to victory! / Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares?

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: After Nightbike reveals that he's afraid of loud noises, the Batwheels help him overcome his fear so he can stop The Penguin from stealing some valuable cargo.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Feeling insecure about his size after a game of Hide-And-Seek, Buff uses the shrink belt belonging to The Atom and accidentally shrinks himself down to the size of a mouse! / Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. But when he needs to use the bat-o-flage and become invisible, he’ll have to learn that doing good is its own reward.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree. Bam will have to get used to having Batgirl in the driver's seat and learn something new if he's going to help her stop Mr. Freeze!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: With Sumush out of town, both Mush-Mush and Fung think that they are now the strongest Mushables in Mushton. But neither of them counts on the strength of Lilit and Miff!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Chep is super happy to have Amanita become a collector as well. Until she starts getting better at collecting than he is!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Our Mushlers discover a super-sticky tree sap and use it to have lots of fun… until Mush-Mush gets stuck to Muddler’s back.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When things go missing from everyone’s home-trees, our Mushlers get on the case to catch the culprit.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Morel notices a Mushlet who is too shy to join in with the others. He realizes why the Mushlet is so shy – they are in awe of Mush-Mush. Morel gets Mush-Mush to boost the Mushlet’s confidence.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Chep discovers he is great at giving snails massages. But the Food and Travel Snails now want massages all the time. Exhausting! Chep has to learn how to tell them NO!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a top-secret Canadian Army prototype that allows you to pass through solid surfaces for a window of several seconds. How can Grizzy prevent the "infiltrating" Lemmings from stealing his jar of chocolate spread?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. Grizzy would like to impress his beloved she-bear by soaring majestically through the sky. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favorite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static. Grizzy rapidly discovers that the true "interference" is the Lemmings, who are using the TV antenna as a diving board for their water games.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to stay in bed all day – even when making his breakfast, brushing his teeth and ordering a pizza! / Mr Paliwal has a new electric go-kart and challenges Mr Bean to a race – so he has to build one from scratch! / Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling - but it's hard work, especially when his fingers get stuck in a ball! / Mr Bean takes free food samples from a food truck at a market and sells them to raise funds for a teapot.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling - but it's hard work, especially when his fingers get stuck in a ball! / Mr Bean takes free food samples from a food truck at a market and sells them to raise funds for a teapot. / Mr Bean wants to watch his favourite TV show with Billy, but Mrs Wicket has other plans. / Mr Bean gate crashes an art exhibition opening party wearing a painted-on tuxedo!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Lilit is under pressure. Truff, the most talented musician in Mushton, has invited her, Mush-Mush and Chep to form a band with him. Only problem is they can hardly play music! Truff insists: they just need to relax and feel the groove. But when Truff tells his new band they will perform at the Food Snail, Lilit isn’t relaxed at all!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Because he has won the moss-ball game last year, Puff is in charge of organizing this Summer’s Picnic. Only Puff isn’t comfortable in that role. Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit offer to help and make sure all the Mushables will follow Puff’s lead. Gradually, Puff gains confidence and ends up bossing everyone around. Now, all the Mushables are about to flee the Picnic!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit notice that Mushpie seems in great shape lately. They want to feel as great as she does and try to discover her secret. When they realise that she works out every morning, our friends decide to join her. And soon, all the Mushables do too. Now Lilit notices that Mushpie doesn’t seem in such great shape anymore…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When Chep asks Mush-Mush and Lilit to go storm-watching and they refuse, Lilit feels bad and convinces Mush-Mush to join their friend. But there are no storms on the horizon. When they notice Chanterelle going through the forest mysteriously, our Mushlers decide to find out what she’s up to instead. That’s when a big storm starts brewing on the horizon...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Fung and Miff have come across a rare piece of bark struck by lightning. Chep desperately wants to add it to his collection, but Fung and Miff have no intention to give it to him. Now remembering every time Chep has been nice to them, Fung and Miff end up doing something they never thought possible…

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings play with poseable figurines of wild Canadian animals. When Grizzy sees that the bear figurine has been put inside a little cage, whereas those of the Lemmings are gathered around a mini-jar of chocolate spread, he decides to join in the party and take control of his own figurine.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a new generation Tamagotchi game on the Ranger's tablet: the camera scans the player and gives him a virtual avatar of himself to take care of. You must feed it, put it to bed, play with it... Grizzy takes his new responsibility as a "parent" very seriously, but the Lemmings decide to complete the virtual Grizzy's education with far more intense activities.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings find a native American Indian vase with a genie inside that will make anyone's dreams come true, if they only let him out by rubbing the vase. There is nonetheless one little snag: the effects of the genie's magic instantly wear off as soon as he returns to his vase and the lid shuts.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings get their hands on a secret weapon that belongs to the Canadian Army: anyone hit with it becomes non-violent. They use the arm to transform Grizzy into a cherub, despite himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When they discover a super fun app that allows you to see yourself as a rabbit or a robot or something else decked out with lots of animated accessories, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. But if they insist on arguing and refuse to share their virtual costumes, they could end up smashing each other's faces in for real.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When they find an old book on traditional Japanese origami, the Lemmings churn out paper birds to play gliding games. Grizzy realizes that he could make the gorgeous butterfly on the cover for his beloved she-bear. But to make the Lemmings bow to his authority, he will first have to become a true origami master.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: L'il Stompers
programme.desc: Häng med Khader, Diddi och de andra små dinosaurierna när de upptäcker världen omkring dem.

programme.title: Go! Go! Cory Carson
programme.desc: Häng med Billy och lillasyster Chrissy på äventyr i Stötfångarstad.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Inget jobb är för stort, ingen valp är för liten!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo och Bluey vill ha ett husdjur! För att visa dem hur mycket jobb det skulle bli, förvandlar Pappa sin hand till deras gamle vän Bosse, en kaotisk, odisciplinerad emu som ställer till problem.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: På bondgården är inget sig likt. Med andra ord är det precis som (o)vanligt för fåret Shaun och gänget.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Greta är en glatt grymtande liten gris som bor med mamma Gris, pappa Gris och lillebror Georg. Greta tycker om att spela spel, leka och klä ut sig men det absolut bästa hon vet är att hoppa i lerpölar.

programme.title: Björnis
programme.desc: Adventskransen. Säsongsstart. På brandstationen förbereder sig Björnis och kollegorna för jul, med pepparkakor och granpynt. Oline och morfar har gjort en fin adventskrans av ris och mossa. När de tänder ljusen börjar kransen plötsligt brinna och Björnis och brandkåren rycker ut för att hjälpa till.

programme.title: Djurungar
programme.desc: Kalv. Den lilla kalven ska ut i hagen för första gången, men det är ganska skrämmande. De andra djuren är mycket större och det är lite läskigt att inte vara nära sin mamma.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Den lilla vita kaninen Miffy ger sig ständigt ut på nya, små äventyr tillsammans med sina vänner. Följ med in i deras färgglada värld och upptäck allt roligt som händer där!

programme.title: Pettson och Findus på nya äventyr
programme.desc: Det går inte en dag utan att katten Findus och gubben Pettson hittar på nya upptåg eller uppfinningar!

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Häng med gänget som använder fantasin för att utforska spännande jobb, yrken och äventyr!

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.desc: Bröderna blobbfisk. Kapten Sjöbjörn och hans besättning av octonauter och vegemaler bor tillsammans på havets botten. Deras uppdrag är att utforska, hjälpa och bevara havens alla varelser.

programme.title: Mumfie
programme.desc: Elefanten Mumfie bor på en liten ö där det alltid är nära till vänner och äventyr.

programme.title: Ellie elefant
programme.desc: Ellie är väldigt bra på att hitta lösningar så alla kan vara med och leka.

programme.title: Interstellar Ella
programme.desc: Långt in i framtiden åker Astronella och hennes vänner på spännande upptäcktsfärder och äventyr. För i rymden finns oändligt många platser att utforska!

programme.title: Coop Troop
programme.desc: Fem osannolika hjältar, som mer än gärna flyr sin tråkiga vardag på gården, ger sig ut på uppdrag för att hjälpa alla djur som behöver det. Med Farmarligan får du (nästan) garanterat det du behöver. Kanske.

programme.title: Smurfarna
programme.desc: De små, blå smurfarna drar ut på äventyr och tillsammans försöker de lura den elake Gargamel.

programme.title: Maya the Bee
programme.desc: Maya är inte som alla andra bin - hon bor nämligen inte i en kupa. Ängen är hennes hem och platsen där hon upplever alla sina äventyr med sina ovanliga vänner - och sin bästis Villy, som trots att han också är ett bi egentligen är en riktig latmask.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: I byn Pontypandy verkar det visst alltid vara fara å färde. Vilken tur att Sam och hans kollegor finns för att hjälpa till!

programme.title: Lånarna
programme.desc: Familjen Chateauflott söker skydd från den gassande solen hos sina lånargrannar.

programme.title: Trolls: TrollsTopia
programme.desc: Poppy vet nu att det finns andra byar med troll utspridda i skogen - alla med olika musiksmak. Hon bjuder in troll från dessa byar för att leva tillsammans i ett experiment som hon kallar TrollsTopia!

programme.title: Cleo löser fallet
programme.desc: Hamstersyskonen Cleo och Ozzy driver en detektivbyrå under Bernards djuraffär mitt i London. Scotland Yards detektiv McFlare är en trogen kund och tillsammans löser de riktigt kluriga fall.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Familjen Nekton bor på ubåten Aronnax och älskar äventyr. Ett av havets största mysterier är Lemurien - en försvunnen civilisation - och flera generationer Nekton har sökt efter denna förlorade värld. Nu med all ny teknik, verkar Lemurien närmare än någonsin.

programme.title: Ranchen
programme.desc: Lena, Anais, Angelo och Hugo delar alla samma intresse - hästar. På Lenas farfars gamla ranch tar de också gärna hand om andra övergivna eller skadade djur. Lenas förmåga som hästlyssnare kommer väl till pass när hon hittar en vanvårdad hingst. Men det måste gå ett år och en dag innan den kan bli hennes.

programme.title: Zorro the Chronicles
programme.desc: I den kanadensiska barnserien "Zorro - Legenden föds" får vi träffa Diego som tonåring. Han står inför sitt livs största utmaningar och slåss för rättvisa mot många grymma och välbeväpnade tyranner! Den mest kända maskerade hjälten är född.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: Föräldralösa Heidi skickas till bergen för att bo hos sin farfar - en allvarlig, sorgtyngd man. Det blir en tuff omställning för Heidi som dock så småningom visar sig mer än kapabel till att klara sig i sitt nya hem. Heidi får snart flera nya vänner och upplever en rad äventyr tillsammans med dem. Del 21: Klara står.

programme.title: Isadora Moon
programme.desc: Isadora är hälften älva, hälften vampyr och alldeles unik. Dessutom stolt över att vara annorlunda, men med föräldrar som hennes går kanske allting inte alltid enligt planen.

programme.title: De tre musketörerna
programme.desc: De är unga, de är modiga, de är starka! Musketörerna beskyddar kungariket från skumma planer!

programme.title: Lilla Aktuellt teckenspråk
programme.desc: Nyheter på svenskt teckenspråk för barn och ungdomar.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Chilli tar med Bluey och Bingo för att hälsa på sin pappa som återhämtar sig efter en hjärtoperation. Morfar borde vila, men han vill hellre följa med barnbarnen på äventyr.

programme.title: Snipp, Snapp, Snut och tråkmånsarna
programme.desc: Snipp, Snapp och Snut vill åka skridskor men isen är för liten för att alla ska få plats. Tråkmånsarna vill sätta stopp för leken men råkar ut för en olycka. Vännerna måste rädda sina fiender och kanske kan Tråkmånsarnas otur leda till något bra för Snipp, Snapp och Snut?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: Thomas är varken det största eller snabbaste tåget men han vill bli det bästa tåget han kan bli! Tillsammans med sina vänner älskar han att vara på äventyr eller bara ha kul.

programme.title: Pippi Långstrump
programme.desc: Som vanligt när Tommy och Annika är på väg hem från skolan, går de förbi Villa Villekulla. Och som vanligt säger de "Tänk om det kunde flytta in någon där, någon som hade barn". Då ser de plötsligt någon röra sig därinne - en gullig liten apa! På verandan står en prickig häst, och inne i huset ligger det någon och sover med fötterna på huvudkudden. Från den dagen blir inget sig likt för Tommy och Annika. Regi: Olle Hellbom. I huvudrollerna: Inger Nilsson, Maria Persson och Pär Sundberg.

programme.title: Maya the Bee
programme.desc: Maya är inte som alla andra bin - hon bor nämligen inte i en kupa. Ängen är hennes hem och platsen där hon upplever alla sina äventyr med sina ovanliga vänner - och sin bästis Villy, som trots att han också är ett bi egentligen är en riktig latmask.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: Varhelst skurkar försöker stjäla åt sig ett djur någonstans i världen finns våra fyra superhjältar med högteknologiska hjälpredor där för att rädda dem!

programme.title: Ainos escape room
programme.desc: I Geografiprovet måste eleverna använda rätt longitud och latitud för att hitta Ainos kod, utan rätt hemliga ord låser de inte upp escape-roomet. Del 3 av 6.

programme.title: Nallen drömmer
programme.desc: Alicia och nallen ska gå ut, men Alicia hittar bara sin ena strumpa. Hon vill hitta den andra som ser likadan ut. Nalle leker med sin klosslåda, men det är svårt att lägga rätt kloss i rätt hål. Kan nallen hjälpa Alicia att hitta sin andra strumpa? Kan Alicia hjälpa nallen så alla klossarna hamnar rätt i klosslådan?

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Animerad serie, fylld av udda personligheter. Gumball är en katt som ofta hamnar i svårigheter tillsammans med sin bäste vän och adoptivbror, den fd guldfisken Darwin. Hans lillasyster Anais är en kanin och ett geni. Skolkamraterna är av blandat slag: exempelvis en jordnöt, en banan och en T-Rex. Familjen är mycket modern, mamma går till jobbet medan pappa sköter marktjänsten.

programme.title: The Unstoppable Yellow Yeti
programme.desc: Kan det bli knasigare än att flytta till en helt ny stad där det alltid är vinter och det dessutom finns en gul yeti? Jodå - mycket knasigare!

programme.title: Pirate Islands
programme.desc: Tre syskon skannas av misstag in i ett dataspel. Där dras de in i ett äventyr fyllt av pirater och skeppsbrutna barn på jakt efter en gömd skatt. Piraterna tror att de märkliga främlingarna kommit för att lägga beslag på skatten och planerar att stoppa dem till varje pris. Kanske är den gömda skatten vägen hem, i så fall måste de hinna före piraterna. Svenska röster: Linn Ehrner, Ima Nilsson, Alexander Kaunitz, Dominique Pålsson Wiklund, Tom Ljungman, Björn Bengtsson, Allan Svensson m.fl.

programme.title: Mustangs FC
programme.desc: Ny säsong med nya utmaningar. Marnie siktar högt och vill komma med i regionlaget men Mustangs behöver nya spelare för att kunna försvara sin ställning. Hur ska det gå för dem utan Ruby? Alla famlar på nya positioner. Säsong 2.

programme.title: Pepparkornen
programme.desc: Rövare och gangsters, tjuvar och banditer. Passa er, här kommer vi och sätter alla bovar bakom galler!

programme.title: Find Me in Paris
programme.desc: När vi sist träffade gänget var Lena kvar i vår tid och Thea fast i historisk tid. Vad ska hända nu? Vem ska hem eller tillbaka och vad är ens hem eller tillbaka? En sak är säker, livet blir inte som någon, vare sig de eller du, kunde tro.

programme.title: Ted's Top Ten
programme.desc: Konstiga vänner? Skilda föräldrar? Ingen chokladtårta? Inga problem, med Ted topp tio-listor hanterar du allt livet kan kasta på dig. Typ.

programme.title: Viljas äventyr
programme.desc: Vilja hjälper en vetenskapsfantast till toppen av ett berg.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Fem tappra hjältar ger sig ut på episka äventyr för att besegra skurkar och lösa kluriga gåtor.

programme.title: Odd Squad
programme.desc: Har din bil någon gång börjat dansa, har ditt hus förvandlats till en rymdraket eller har siffrorna i din mattebok försvunnit spårlöst? Agenterna på KLURO löser problemen.

programme.title: Let's Go, Bananas!
programme.desc: Tre tokigt unika familjer delar livets kärlek, kaos, triumfer och utbrott i berättelser deras fantastiska barns perspektiv!

programme.title: Millie Magnificent
programme.desc: Kreativitet är alltid bättre när man är flera! Steffi har visserligen bra idéer men fantasi-gänget behövs för att det ska bli storslaget. I det här fallet...

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Charlie hänger ofta ute med sin kompis Marv. Han gillar fotboll, raketer och att hitta på historier. Han gillar också sin lillasyster Lola. Det är bara en sak - hon är väldigt bestämd och envis. Svenska röster: Jakob Bergström, Ella Andersson, Mathilda Smedius, Benjamin Wahlgren m.fl.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Greta är en glatt grymtande liten gris som bor med mamma Gris, pappa Gris och lillebror Georg. Greta tycker om att spela spel, leka och klä ut sig men det absolut bästa hon vet är att hoppa i lerpölar.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Säsong 2. Del 16/40. Det hyllade animationsbolaget Aardman (Wallace Gromit, Flykten från hönsgården) ligger bakom denna leranimerade serie om fåret Shaun. Han bor på en bondgård tillsammans med sin brokiga flock, där de hittar på massa bus men också får arbeta hårt för att bonden inte ska upptäcka hur smarta de är. På gården finns också den hårt prövade fårhunden Bitzer som försöker hålla ordning på alla djur.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: Molang är en glad och energisk kanin vars bästa vän är kycklingen Piu Piu.

programme.title: Tripp, Trapp, Träd
programme.desc: Vassa tänder. Idag hittar Tripp och Trapp såpbubblor som de tar sig över sjön med. I biografen visas en film om Lilja som ska träna brasiliansk jiu-jitsu. Bokfågeln berättar godnattsagan "Vit haj".

programme.title: Koumis djurbok
programme.desc: Här är en kejsarpingvin. Kejsarpingvinerna bor på Sydpolen, i Antarktis islandskap. Papporna väntar tålmodigt på mammorna som söker föda i havet. När de återvänder känner varje par igen varandra genom sin unika sång.

programme.title: Koumis djurbok
programme.desc: Här är en härfågel. Koumi utforskar härfågeln. Den har randiga fjädrar och en vacker fjäderkam på hjässan. Visste du att deras ungar försvarar sig genom att spruta avföring på inkräktare?

programme.title: Eläinten ystäviä
programme.desc: Kaniner. Moa träffar kaninerna Mustikka och Mansikka. De leker och gosar tillsammans. I programmet används svenska och finska tecken som stöd (TAKK, tecken som alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation).

programme.title: Smurfarna
programme.desc: De små, blå smurfarna drar ut på äventyr och tillsammans försöker de lura den elake Gargamel.

programme.title: Uträknad
programme.desc: Allt slutar på vinden. I källaren kämpar Billie för att inte bli nedsövd samtidigt som hennes tid för att rentvå sig själv från stöldanklagelserna håller på att rinna ut. Huvudpersonen får bland annat lära sig om de fyra räknesätten och skillnaden mellan bråk och algebraiska uttryck.

programme.title: Eli och Roffe i puberteten
programme.desc: Vänskap. Varför blir Roffe sur över att Eli gör en film med andra kompisar, trots att hon frågade om Roffe ville vara med? Kanske kan han ändra sig? Man kan ju ha fler vänner än en. Vänskap är underbart, men inte alltid så lätt.

programme.title: Så funkar Sverige
programme.desc: Naturtillgångar. Hur har Sverige blivit ett rikt land? Varför är den svenska naturen viktig och vad är allemansrätten?

programme.title: Lilla Aktuellt
programme.desc: Dagens viktigaste nyheter för unga tittare.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess
programme.desc: Tonårsflickan Alex går i skolan och spelar i en orkester. När hon fyller 16 möter hon indiern Kuru och hans elefant. Han säger att hon är en prinsessa och direkt arvtagare till landet Manjipur. Ska hon bestämma sig för att bli drottning där eller att stanna i Melbourne? Svenska röster: Josephine Bornebusch, Gabriel Odenhammar, Anna Sahlin, Julia Dufvenius m.fl.

programme.title: Grizzy och lämlarna
programme.desc: Grizzlybjörnen Grizzy flyttar in i en till synes övergiven skogvaktarstuga. Äntligen ska han få njuta av alla moderna bekvämligheter som finns! Tyvärr har en stor lämmelfamilj fått samma idé så det blir inte riktigt som han har tänkt sig.

programme.title: Sealook
programme.desc: Ett gäng lekfulla sälar navigerar livet tillsammans och kommer överens trots sina olika personligheter och busiga upptåg.

programme.title: Stan & Gran
programme.desc: Kustkroka - en plats fylld av naturens mysterier! Mysterier som är till för att lösas!

programme.title: Andy's dino island
programme.desc: Det är dags att ge sig ut på äventyr på Dinosaurie-ön!

programme.title: Akta dig
programme.desc: Idag blir det storstädning - och Sam vill hjälpa till. Pappa ser förstås bara giftiga rengöringsmedel, kvävande damm och en livsfarlig tur till återvinningen. Men kanske är det inte Sam som behöver akta sig mest?

programme.title: Fixarjulen
programme.desc: Plötsligt sitter inspektören bara där vid bordet på morgonen. Han verkar medtagen och förändrad. När Malin frågar om nedläggningen av programmet river han dokumentet. Fixarjulen är räddad! Och Trolf ger Ellen en förlösande idé om hur hon äntligen ska göra något kul med flugsvampar. Har turen börjat vända?

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes

programme.title: Iso kiltti jätti (7)
programme.desc: "Iso Kiltti Jätti" kertoo tarinan nuoresta tytöstä ja Jätistä, joka esittelee tytölle Jättiläisten maan ihmeitä ja vaaroja. IKJ on itsekin jätti, mutta Iso kiltti jätti, eikä yhtään samanlainen kuin Jättiläisten maan muut asukit. Saavuttuaan Jättiläisten maahan Sohvi, 10-vuotias näppärä tyttö Lontoosta, pelästyy ensin salaperäistä jättiä, joka on tuonut tytön luolaansa, mutta tajuaa pian, että IKJ on itse asiassa oikein ystävällinen. Sohvi ei ole ennen tavannut jättiläistä, joten hänellä on paljon kysyttävää. Sohvi ja IKJ ovat kumpikin olleet aika yksinäisiä, mutta nyt heistä tulee nopeasti ystäviä. Sohvin läsnäolo Jättiläisten maassa herättää kuitenkin kiinnostusta muissa jättiläisissä, joista tulee vähitellen yhä isompi riesa. Yhdessä he laativat suunnitelman, jolla jättiläisistä päästään ikiajoiksi eroon.

programme.title: Hyppelihiiri Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä (7)
programme.desc: Hyppelihiiri Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä perustuu norjalaisen Thorbjørn Egnerin samannimiseen satuklassikkoon, joka on valloittanut lukijoita 1950-luvulta alkaen. Hurmaavana nukkeanimaationa toteutettu elokuva kertoo Hyppelihiiren, Martti Metsähiiren, leipurimestari Jänöliinin ja heidän eläinystäviensä elämästä Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä. Metsä on muuten mukava paikka asua, mutta pienten eläinten on jatkuvasti varottava isompiaan - erityisesti Mikko Repolaista. Kun Samuli Siilikin yrittää syödä suihinsa Martti Metsähiiren mummon, on korkea aika säätää laki, jotta elämään metsässä saataisiin tolkku: tästedes kaikkien metsän eläinten tulee olla ystäviä eikä kukaan saa syödä toista.

programme.title: Croodit (0)
programme.desc: Lähde mukaan Croodien huikealle matkalle tässä eeppisessä komediaseikkailussa Madagascar- ja Näin koulutat lohikäärmeesi -elokuvien tekijöiltä. Ikimuistoisten henkilöiden, värikkäiden otusten ja vehreiden maisemien lisäksi Croodit tarjoaa takuuvarmasti naurua ja hupia kaikenikäisille!

programme.title: My Robot Brother (7)
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuudessa on valoisaa, vihreää ja ihanaa – ja jokaisella lapsella on jopa oma ihmisenkaltainen robotti. 12-vuotiaalla Albertella sen sijaan on hyvin vanhanaikainen robotti, joka lähinnä muistuttaa isoa nallea. Albertesta tulee suosittu, kun hän saa syntymäpäivälahjaksi markkinoiden uusimman humanoidimallin. Hän on Konrad, aidoimman oloinen robotti, jota koskaan on nähty. Vähitellen Alberte alkaa tuntea aitoa yhteyttä Konradiin – mutta voiko ihminen ylipäätään olla ystävä robotin kanssa?

programme.title: Kayara: seikkailulla Inkojen mailla (7)
programme.desc: Kauan sitten inkojen lähettiläät (chasquit) olivat nopeita, vahvoja ja yksinomaan miehiä. Kayara taas on päättänyt olla ensimmäinen nainen, joka pääsee mukaan tuohon valikoituun joukkoon. Uskaliaan retkensä aikana hän puolustaa tuolloin vielä löytämätöntä Kultaista kaupunkia suurilta vaaroilta, jotka liittyvät riistoon ja varastettuihin luonnonvaroihin.

programme.title: Late Lammas - Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Late on älykäs pieni lammas, joka asuu katraansa kanssa Sammalperän maatilalla. Maatilan omistaa likinäköinen Maajussi ja sitä vahtii kontrolli-intoinen, mutta hyvää tarkoittava Vuhku Vahtikoira. Elämä Sammalperässä on yleisesti ottaen mukavaa, mutta eräänä päivänä Late havahtuu ja tuntee elävänsä kuin orja. Late alkaa suunnittella vapaapäivää, ja suunnitelmaan kuuluu Maajussin saaminen unten maille. Suunnitelma toimii liiankin hyvin ja pian alkaa tapahtua. Yksi asia johtaa toiseen ja pian koko katras löytää itsensä ensimmäistä kertaa farmin ulkopuolelta - isosta kaupungista. Mutta miten lampaat pärjäävät suurkaupungissa? HUOM! Elokuvassa ei ole puhetta.

programme.title: GOAT: Kaikkien aikojen paras (7)
programme.desc: Sony Pictures Animation, studion takana "Spider-Man™: Across the Spider-Verse", ja KPop Demon Huntersin luoneet taiteilijat esittävät: "GOAT: Kaikkien aikojen paras", eläinmaailman action-komedian. Nuori vuohi Will saa tilaisuuden liittyä ammattilaisiin pelaamaan roarballia – intensiivistä ja fyysistä lajia, jossa kilpailevat maailman nopeimmat eläimet.

programme.title: Goosebumps (12)
programme.desc: Muutettuaan pikkukaupunkiin Zach Cooper näkee asian valoisan puolen, kun hän tapaa naapurissa asuvan Hannahin, Goosebumpsmenestyskirjasarjan tekijän R. L. Stinen tyttären. Stinen kirjojen kuuluisat hirviöt ovatkin oikeasti olemassa, ja hän suojelee lukijoitaan pitämällä hirviöt lukittuina kirjojen käsikirjoituksissa. Kun hirviöt pääsevät vahingossa vapaaksi, Stinen, Zachin ja Hannahin tehtävänä on vangita ne takaisin kirjoihinsa.

programme.title: Himoshoppaajan salaiset unelmat (7)
programme.desc: Sophie Kinsellan suosittuun kirjasarjaan perustuva Himoshoppaajan salaiset unelmat toistaa giltsifilkkojen kliseitä: haussa on paitsi unelmien mies myös menestys työuralla. Talousalan lehteen kirjoittavalla Rebecca Bloomwoodilla (Isla Fisher) on salaisuus. Kansantajuisilla kolumneilla suosioon noussut journalisti ei nimittäin osaa pitää omia raha-asioitaan kurissa. Ostokoukkuun jäänyt Becky ylittää tilinsä kerran toisensa jälkeen. Pian perässä roikkuu sitkeä perintävirkailija. Tuskastuttavan höpsö mutta sydämellinen Becky Bloomwood seuraa Helen Fieldingin luoman Bridget Jonesin jalanjälkiä. Isla Fischer on uusi ja raikas komediakasvo. Hän lyö roolinsa yli ilmeisen harkitusti ja tekee Beckystä lapsenkaltaisen bimbon. Komediasta kehittyy kuitenkin vastuullisempaan kuluttamiseen oppivan naisen kasvutarina.

programme.title: Uusia Alkuja (15)
programme.desc: Hittielokuvan Once ohjanneen John Carneyn uusi musiikkielokuva. Gretta (Keira Knightley) ja hänen pitkäaikainen poikaystävänsä (Adam Levine) muuttavat New Yorkiin haaveenaan musiikkitähteys. Pian Gretta jää kuitenkin yksin sydän särkyneenä, kun poikaystävä jättää hänet menestyksekkään soolouransa sokaisemana. Kun huono-onninen musiikkituottaja (Mark Ruffalo) kuulee Grettan esiintyvän paikallisessa baarissa, tunnistaa hän heti naisen lahjakkuuden ja aitouden. Heistä tulee toistensa viimeinen mahdollisuus päästä pinnalle. UUSIA ALKUJA on koskettava tarina siitä, kuinka kaksi kadonnutta sielua kohtaavat toisensa ja löytävät yhdessä uuden sävelen.

programme.title: Step Up (7)
programme.desc: Ohjaaja: Anne Fletcher, USA 2006, 104'. Channing Tatum, Jenna Dewan, Damaine Radcliffe, De'Shawn Washington, Drew Sidora. Tanssin hurmaa pulppuava draama köyhästä Tylerista, joka asuu kasvattivanhempiensa luona Baltimoren slummissa ja rikkaasta Norasta, joka asuu hienossa talossa äitinsä kanssa. Kahta erilaista nuorta yhdistää rakkaus tanssiin. Mitä tapahtuu, kun Tyler päätyy siivoamaan taidekouluun jossa Nora opiskelee, ja tyttö tarvitsee koulun loppuesitykseen kipeästi tanssiparia...?

programme.title: Hachiko - tarina uskollisuudesta (0)
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva elokuva kertoo liikuttavan tarinan Hachiko -nimisestä löytökoirasta, jonka Richard Geren esittämä professori pelastaa kadulta. Isäntä kuolee yllättäen, eikä eräänä päivänä enää palaakaan töistä kotiin. Uskollinen Hachiko ei luovuta, vaan on päivittäin vastassa isäntäänsä juna-asemalla odottaen tätä kotiin - vuosikausien ajan. Hachiko-elokuva pohjautuu japanilaiseen tositarinaan Akita-rotuisesta tokyolaiskoira Hachikosta. Koiran tarina on 1930-luvulta saakka innoittanut Japanissa satuja sekä menestyselokuvan (Hachikô Monogatari, 1987). Kolme pronssipatsasta on valettu koiran muistolle ympäri maan, joista kuuluisin on muodostunut kohtauspaikaksi Tokyon Shibuyan juna-aseman "Hachiko Exit" -uloskäynnillä.

programme.title: Kayara: seikkailulla Inkojen mailla (7)

Uskaliaan retkensä aikana hän puolustaa tuolloin vielä löytämätöntä Kultaista kaupunkia suurilta vaaroilta, jotka liittyvät riistoon ja varastettuihin luonnonvaroihin.

programme.title: Late Lammas - Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Late on älykäs pieni lammas, joka asuu katraansa kanssa Sammalperän maatilalla. Maatilan omistaa likinäköinen Maajussi ja sitä vahtii kontrolli-intoinen, mutta hyvää tarkoittava Vuhku Vahtikoira. Elämä Sammalperässä on yleisesti ottaen mukavaa, mutta eräänä päivänä Late havahtuu ja tuntee elävänsä kuin orja. Late alkaa suunnittella vapaapäivää, ja suunnitelmaan kuuluu Maajussin saaminen unten maille. Suunnitelma toimii liiankin hyvin ja pian alkaa tapahtua. Yksi asia johtaa toiseen ja pian koko katras löytää itsensä ensimmäistä kertaa farmin ulkopuolelta - isosta kaupungista. Mutta miten lampaat pärjäävät suurkaupungissa? HUOM! Elokuvassa ei ole puhetta.

Tätä mieltä ovat ainakin heidän vanhempansa, kuningas Vilhelm ja kuningatar Alberta, jotka kumpikin hallitsevat valtakuntiaan. Mutta ilkeä Rupert-velho on päättänyt estää häät. programme.title: Titanic (12)

Laivan törmätessä jäävuoreen hyytävällä Atlantilla, nuorten rakastavaisten matka muuttuu henkeäsalpaavaksi selviytymistaisteluksi.

programme.title: Himoshoppaajan salaiset unelmat (7)

Talousalan lehteen kirjoittavalla Rebecca Bloomwoodilla (Isla Fisher) on salaisuus. Kansantajuisilla kolumneilla suosioon noussut journalisti ei nimittäin osaa pitää omia raha-asioitaan kurissa. Ostokoukkuun jäänyt Becky ylittää tilinsä kerran toisensa jälkeen. Pian perässä roikkuu sitkeä perintävirkailija. Tuskastuttavan höpsö mutta sydämellinen Becky Bloomwood seuraa Helen Fieldingin luoman Bridget Jonesin jalanjälkiä. Isla Fischer on uusi ja raikas komediakasvo. Hän lyö roolinsa yli ilmeisen harkitusti ja tekee Beckystä lapsenkaltaisen bimbon. Komediasta kehittyy kuitenkin vastuullisempaan kuluttamiseen oppivan naisen kasvutarina.

programme.title: Uusia Alkuja (15)

Pian Gretta jää kuitenkin yksin sydän särkyneenä, kun poikaystävä jättää hänet menestyksekkään soolouransa sokaisemana. programme.title: Astrid Lindgrens jul
programme.desc: Tule mukaan Astrid Lindgrenin joulunviettoon! SF on koonnut yhteen joulujaksoja Lindgrenin tunnetuimmista tarinoista. Nauti satumaisesta talvesta ja joulun tunnelmasta. Peppi saa Tommilta ja Annikalta jännittävän joululahjan, Pukarikadun Lotta etsii joulukuusta, Ronja tapaa joulutonttuja ja Eemeli aiheuttaa säpinää Kissankulmalla. Ihanaa valkoista joulua!

programme.title: Veijarikopla tulee taas (7)
programme.desc: Neljännessä Jönssonliigaelokuvassa Sickan kumppaneineen sekaantuu poliittisiin juonitteluihin. Kaikki alkaa kunniallisella Ikean kaappausyrityksellä. Sickan kuitenkin huomaa, että joku käyttää Ikean huonekaluja aseiden salakuljetukseen.

programme.desc: Kausi 2, 6/8. Tomas tulee mustasukkaiseksi huomattuaan isänsä olevan hyvää pataa Matsin kanssa ja yrittää päästä lähentymään tämän kanssa. Klara puolestaan on huolissaan isänsä terveydentilasta ja rakkauselämän vaikutuksesta siihen. Lily tuskailee yksityisyyden puutetta tullessaan yhtenään häirityksi. Ruotsalaisessa komediasarjassa eri sukupolvet viettävät kesää saaristoparatiisissa, ja yhteentörmäyksiltä ei voida välttyä.
